name: 12159 · Slingerlands, NY
findings: ZIP 12159 (Slingerlands) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12159 (Slingerlands) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 12159 (Slingerlands) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
